resources.string: Search for a song or video
Search and tap a result to play on the car
For video: open ipanHub under Navigation in the car launcher (enable Unknown sources on the phone if sideloaded).
Queue is empty — search and tap Play now
Pick a song on the phone

In Android Auto split view, the head unit may give ipanHub a media card without a video surface when another navigation app is active. Audio keeps playing. Open ipanHub full screen on the car display, or select ipanHub as the active navigation app in the launcher, to restore video.
Search on your phone, then play here

1) End or cancel the Waze route (not only close Waze).
2) In Android Auto settings, open ipanHub as a Navigation app (not Media).
3) Tap Take map on ipanHub, or open ipanHub from the launcher before starting Waze again.

Android Auto allows only one active navigation app. While Waze has a live route it can take the map card back automatically.
Waiting for a video from your phone…
For safety, use only while parked.
Controls could not be shown. Playback may continue on the surface.
Shows when video is playing on Android Auto
Video on car needs Play-source install. Tap for steps.
Play-source install OK — open ipanHub from AA apps (navigation).
Android Auto blocks template (video surface) apps unless they are installed with Google Play as the installer package. Unknown sources does not fix this.

Windows steps: enable USB debugging, connect phone, run platform-tools adb. Uninstall ipanHub first. From the folder containing cartube-debug.apk run the command below. Full guide: docs/VIDEO_ON_CAR.md in the repo.
No PC? Use Shizuku plus UnknownAuto on the phone (GitHub) to install with Play attribution. Root not required on most devices.
After reinstall: Android Auto developer Unknown sources ON, Customize launcher, pick ipanHub under apps/navigation (not Media only).
